items.title: A Vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support Could Allow for Arbitrary Upload of Files
items.summary: A vulnerability has been discovered in BeyondTrust Remote Support that could allow for arbitrary upload of files. BeyondTrust Remote Support is an enterprise secure remote access solution that enables IT teams to securely access and troubleshoot remote endpoints. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could allow a remote attacker to perform file operations on an affected appliance.
